learning_outcomes.text: Students master the essential fundamentals of system theory. They know the mathematical description of signals and systems in the time domain and their essential characteristics.
They know the basics of probability theory and can calculate with discrete and continuous random variables.
They understand the basic concepts of information theory and can apply them.

syllabus_topics: Signals, characteristic quantities and properties of signals, elementary operations, signal synthesis and signal analysis, periodic signals, analog-to-digital and digital-to-analog conversion, linear and nonlinear systems
Introduction and definitions, multi-stage random experiments, discrete random variables, continuous random variables
Fundamental questions of information theory, entropy concepts, applications
assessment_rules: Successful passing of the module examination is required for credit allocation. The grade of this module contributes 5/138 to the final grade.
